db.description: Database name from list_databases (omit .sqlite); required when multiple databases exist.

description: List favorite folders for the authenticated LitRadar user.

name: list_journal_options
description: List journal filter options for the selected LitRadar database.

db.description: Database name from list_databases (omit .sqlite); required when multiple databases exist.

name: list_journal_ratings
description: List exact UTD, ABS, FMS and FMS China grades with journal counts for the selected database. Empty groups mean no rating information.

db.description: Database name from list_databases (omit .sqlite); required when multiple databases exist.

name: list_journals
description: List journals from the selected LitRadar database.

abs_rating.description: Exact ABS grades; 4* is a literal grade, not a wildcard.

db.description: Database name from list_databases (omit .sqlite); required when multiple databases exist.

utd_rating.description: Exact UTD grades; OR within a system, AND across systems and other filters.

name: list_years
description: List publication years for the selected LitRadar database.

db.description: Database name from list_databases (omit .sqlite); required when multiple databases exist.

name: remove_favorite
description: Remove an article from a favorite folder for the authenticated user.

name: search_articles
description: Search articles: list_databases, then search_articles with db, then get_article for one record. Default keywords requires all words to match; advanced supports FTS5 AND/OR/NOT, "exact phrase", NEAR(), title: column filters and prefix*.

abs_rating.description: Exact ABS grades; 4* is a literal grade, not a wildcard.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page; keep the same filters and sort.

db.description: Database name from list_databases (omit .sqlite); required when multiple databases exist.

include_total.description: Include the full filtered total count; defaults to true on the first page and false with a cursor.

limit.description: Maximum articles per page (1-200); defaults to 50.

q.description: Full-text query (max 2048 characters); keywords matches all whitespace-separated chunks, advanced interprets FTS5 syntax.

search_mode.description: Query mode; defaults to keywords. Use advanced for explicit FTS5 syntax.

sort.description: Publication date order; defaults to date:desc.

utd_rating.description: Exact UTD grades; OR within a system, AND across systems and other filters.
